title: Finite-limit sketch signature for small R-linear dg categories
statement: Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal V$ as in [def-weil-size-convention] and a commutative ring $R\in\mathcal U$. A finite-limit sketch and its Set-valued models mean those of [lem-coef-finite-limit-sketch-models]. The following signature admits a $\mathcal U$-small indexing category and a $\mathcal U$-small family of specified finite product and pullback cones, defining a sketch $S_R$. Its primary sorts are $O$ and $A_n$ for every $n\in\mathbf Z$, with $s_n,t_n:A_n\to O$. It has the sort $B=O\times O$, the map $p_n=(s_n,t_n):A_n\to B$, the parallel-pair sorts $A_n\times_B A_n$, the composable-pair sorts $A_q\times_O A_p$ (where $s_q$ equals $t_p$), and the finite tuple sorts needed for the equations below. The operations are $z_n:B\to A_n$, negation and scalar multiplication by each $r\in R$ on $A_n$, addition on parallel pairs, $1:O\to A_0$, composition $c_{q,p}:A_q\times_O A_p\to A_{p+q}$, and $d_n:A_n\to A_{n+1}$. All preserve the appropriate endpoints; $p_nz_n=1_B$ and $s_0 1=t_0 1=1_O$. Relations impose the $R$-module equations in each fiber of $p_n$, associativity and two-sided units for composition, bilinearity of composition, linearity of $d$, and, on each appropriate tuple sort, $d(1)=0$, $d_{n+1}d_n=z_{n+2}p_n$, and $d(ba)=d(b)a+(-1)^q b\,d(a)$ for $b\in A_q$, $a\in A_p$. Each tuple-valued expression used in these equations is an arrow to the corresponding product or pullback vertex, with its composites with the projections prescribed by the expression; the same convention is closed under the substitutions of well-typed finite expressions. The indexing category is the free category on these sorts, operation and tuple arrows and cone projections modulo these equations. Only the stated finite product and pullback cones are required to be limit cones.
